scope: Read actual Q1/Hu and accepted-force storage source; distinguish original weak residual from an energy gradient and define the smallest nonduplicate generalized edge/corner observation. No NPZ, candidate/API, HP, new integral, plot or formal repository mutation.

tensor_and_operator_contract.derivative_coordinates: Undeformed physical reference X,Y. Rectangles are equal, axis aligned; hx and hy are their widths.
tensor_and_operator_contract.quadrature_order: q=3*xi_index+eta_index, each index ordered(-1,0,+1): xi varies slowly and eta quickly. Top eta=+1 is q2,5,8.
tensor_and_operator_contract.split_authority: Lift and fluctuation are accumulated separately into retained DD kinematic pairs. Material P and Hu are DD through original weak contractions. Exported observations are independently rounded binary64.

original_weak_residual.mathematical_symbols: u_ai=lift_ai+fluctuation_ai symbolically; F_qiJ=delta_iJ+sum_a u_ai grad_qaj; J_q=det F_q; h_i=(uBL_i-uBR_i+uTR_i-uTL_i)/(hx*hy).
original_weak_residual.Hu: Hu_iXY=Hu_iYX=h_i and Hu_iXX=Hu_iYY=0; Hu is constant within each reference Q1 rectangle.
original_weak_residual.material: r_material[a,i]=sum_q w_q P[q,i,J] grad[q,a,J]. P=mu F+(lambda logJ-mu)F^(-T), evaluated by the original compensated arithmetic.
original_weak_residual.coefficient: c_e(u)=kr*sum_q w_q exp(-5 J_q). This is element-local despite scalar model kr, and includes original thickness. c_e is not exported by native_mean capture.
original_weak_residual.Hu_force: r_Hu[a,i]=c_e*sum_JK Hu[i,J,K]*H[a,J,K]. Both XY and YX contribute: no factor-one replacement is valid.
original_weak_residual.total: r_total=r_material+r_Hu in original DD before export rounding; the saved three force observations are not interchangeable by a new binary64 total=material+Hu gate.
original_weak_residual.virtual_action: For a Q1 virtual nodal field v, r_e dot v_e = sum_q w_q P_q:grad(v_q) + c_e Hu:D2(v_e). This is a weak covector evaluated at the actual state, not a declaration that it is d(total_energy).
original_weak_residual.on_body_sign: Existing ON-body force is minus the internal element/global weak covector. Holding reaction uses the opposite convention.

energy_gradient_judgment.conclusion: The actual general Hu force is not the gradient of the naive scalar E_Hu=one_half*c_e(u)*||Hu(u)||_F^2. The general residual is not supplied as a total potential gradient by this code.
energy_gradient_judgment.naive_energy_variation: dE_Hu[v]=c_e Hu:D2v + one_half*||Hu||_F^2*dc_e[v]. The original force contains only the first term.
energy_gradient_judgment.dc_e: dc_e[v]=-5 kr sum_q w_q exp(-5J_q) (cof(F_q):grad(v_q)). No such J-derivative force term appears in either original residual source.
energy_gradient_judgment.actual_tangent: AD differentiates the actual residual c_e H^T Hu, so its directional derivative includes dc_e[v]*H^T Hu + c_e H^T D2v. This tangent contribution is different from adding the omitted energy-gradient term to force.
energy_gradient_judgment.generic_integrability: With constant K=H^T H, Dr_Hu=c_e K+(Ku) outer grad(c_e). Its antisymmetric part is (Ku) outer grad(c_e)-grad(c_e) outer (Ku), generally nonzero. An affine virtual field has H v=0 but can change J/c_e when Hu is nonzero; a mixed Q1 field changes Hu. Thus general symmetry/integrability cannot be inferred.
energy_gradient_judgment.special_cases: kr=0, Hu=0, a frozen c_e, or special state/direction restrictions may remove an offending term locally. This source-only derivation does not calculate antisymmetry for any actual saved state or matrix.
energy_gradient_judgment.material_energy_caution: Material P has the standard Neo-Hookean constitutive interpretation, but the near-zero exported auxiliary energy uses a truncated stable remainder and is explicitly not used for P or residual Jacobian. Mechanical mode omits that energy entirely. Existing HP energy is archived without candidate energy qualification.
energy_gradient_judgment.implementation_consequence: Do not add the omitted energy-gradient term as a repair and do not compare original total reaction to a naive total-energy finite difference. Either would change the model or use an inapplicable oracle. Use the original residual virtual action for generalized boundary meaning.

canonical_element_Hu_corner_identity.on_body_vertex_covector: For selected body vertices, negate the corresponding internal entry; do not include unselected vertices.
canonical_element_Hu_corner_identity.action: W_Hu(v)=beta dot(vBL-vBR+vTR-vTL). This represents the original Q1 action at element vertices, and is a concrete signed generalized corner action. Element vertices include ordinary assembled interface nodes; this is not a claim that forces exist only at macroscopic workpiece corners.
canonical_element_Hu_corner_identity.full_rigid_translation: For vBL=vBR=vTR=vTL=constant, W_Hu=0. All four vertex internal vectors sum to zero symbolically.
canonical_element_Hu_corner_identity.side_pair_translation: Any adjacent pair of vertices has opposite Hu signs. A common translation on that selected pair and zero virtual field on the other pair has zero Hu action, because its Q1 shape sum is affine and D2chi=0.
canonical_element_Hu_corner_identity.single_vertex: A corner_only support element selecting one body vertex retains its signed beta action; single-node basis is not affine.
canonical_element_Hu_corner_identity.matrix_or_scalar_pressure_limit: A beta vector is force N conjugate to the vertex value combination. It is not a scalar pressure MPa, and choosing its normal component does not establish pressure or effective-grip qualification.

element_local_hyperstress_representation.quadrature_representation: M_qiJK=kr exp(-5J_q) Hu_iJK satisfies sum_q w_q M_q:D2v=c_e Hu:D2v for Q1 v. This is a quadrature weak representation, not evidence of a known true continuous hyperstress trace.
element_local_hyperstress_representation.constant_Q1_equivalent: Choose Mbar_eiJK=(c_e/(thickness*hx*hy))*Hu_iJK. Then thickness*integral_rectangle Mbar:D2v dA equals the same original Q1 Hu action, because D2v and Hu are constant.
element_local_hyperstress_representation.density_units: Mbar is MPa*mm=N/mm; its thickness-weighted boundary derivative action has force units N. beta=2*thickness*Mbar_iXY.
element_local_hyperstress_representation.uniqueness_limit: The constant representation is a declared Q1-equivalent reconstruction. It is not the original pointwise kr exp(-5J) Hu field, and no original unique continuous field or boundary trace follows from the finite nodal covector. Other fields with the same quadrature/virtual action can have different traces.
element_local_hyperstress_representation.generic_integration_by_parts: For a chosen sufficiently smooth P(X),M(X), W=thickness*integral[P_iJ v_i,J+M_iJK v_i,JK]dA. Let A_iJ=P_iJ-partial_K M_iJK, b_iJ=n_K M_iJK. On each oriented edge, edge_value_traction=n_J A_iJ-partial_s(tau_J b_iJ), edge_normal_derivative_action=n_J b_iJ, and endpoint action=[tau_J b_iJ*v_i]_start^end; interior term is -partial_J A_iJ*v_i.
element_local_hyperstress_representation.constant_Q1_specialization: For constant offdiagonal Mbar on an axis-aligned rectangle, Div(Mbar)=0, edge normal-derivative action Mbar_nn=0, and tangent b_s is constant. Its Hu action reduces to four oriented endpoint/corner terms; with CCW edges it is +2*thickness*Mbar_iXY at BL/TR and -2*thickness*Mbar_iXY at BR/TL.
element_local_hyperstress_representation.no_pressure_addition: This canonical constant Hu choice produces endpoint/derivative action, not an ordinary Hu pressure added to P@N. Discarding the endpoint terms would discard original virtual work.

interface_edges_and_corner_support.outside_bottom_owner: Body pair is local TL/TR on outer-cell top edge. Internal pair is[-beta,+beta]; ON-body in left-to-right order is[+beta,-beta]. Its action is beta dot(v_left-v_right).
interface_edges_and_corner_support.outside_left_owner: Body pair is local BR/TR on outer-cell right edge. ON-body bottom-to-top is[+beta,-beta].
interface_edges_and_corner_support.outside_right_owner: Body pair is local BL/TL on outer-cell left edge. ON-body bottom-to-top is[-beta,+beta].
interface_edges_and_corner_support.assembled_edge_node: After assembling neighbouring owner endpoints, signed differences of owner beta values can act at an interior body-edge node. This is a discrete owner endpoint/jump observation; it does not establish the trace or jump of a true continuous hyperstress field.
interface_edges_and_corner_support.net_Hu_condition: For the complete fixed lower-half square topology already encoded in saved_material_support: body cells have all four fixed zero displacement vertices and Hu=0; every noncorner outside owner contributes a selected adjacent pair with zero symbolic resultant. Consequently the whole signed body Hu resultant is supplied by the remaining corner_only single-node support elements, in exact mathematical arithmetic.
interface_edges_and_corner_support.actual_value_limit: No actual Hu field, coefficient, beta, endpoint cancellation, owner jump or corner resultant has been read or computed in this source-only preparation. Export rounding/scatter order must be respected by any future observation; this conclusion is conditional on the actual fixed-square topology and original operator contract, not an observed numerical equality.
interface_edges_and_corner_support.corner_attribution_limit: A macroscopic corner node also receives side-owner endpoints and corner_only element terms. All must remain owner-resolved; the original net node force cannot be uniquely called pressure on either incident face.

material_P_and_total_boundary_limit.current_material_data: Nine saved P owner samples plus original material nodal weak force exist. They do not uniquely specify a true continuous P field or its divergence.
material_P_and_total_boundary_limit.material_action_not_just_trace: For any chosen smooth P reconstruction, material weak force equals the full boundary nodal traction integral minus its interior Div(P) virtual-field integral. A single body-facing P@N trace is not generally the selected nodal material weak action.
material_P_and_total_boundary_limit.possible_declared_reconstruction: A tensor-product biquadratic interpolant through the nine Simpson points is one explicit choice. For Q1 test fields, products P_h*grad(v), edge(P_h*v), and Div(P_h)*v have degrees within tensor Simpson exactness, yielding a symbolic discrete integration-by-parts identity. This would be a new interpolation/derivative/integration observation with its own scope, not the true DivP or an established physical cause.
material_P_and_total_boundary_limit.minimal_route: Do not introduce that P reconstruction just to complete the Hu corner function. Reuse authoritative saved material/total weak node forces; add only owner-resolved Hu endpoint/corner meaning where needed. A stronger total face-pressure claim still requires an explicit material recovery, Hu boundary convention and physical qualification.

minimum_nonduplicate_implementable_funct.proposed_capability: A saved-state Q1 Hu owner endpoint/corner weak-action observer: trace original element regularization force to body vertices, distinguish side-owner adjacent pairs from corner_only single vertices, retain signs/owner identity, and expose what cancels for body translation and what remains at corners. Integrate or link this explanation with the existing total/material/Hu response and actual-state viewer.
minimum_nonduplicate_implementable_funct.authoritative_input: Prefer original saved element_regularization_force plus original connectivity/edofs and existing body/owner/corner metadata. native_mean.capture already stores element_regularization_force and global_regularization_force. The original accepted storage exports rounded J and Hu but not retained J/Hu pairs or c_e; do not rebuild exp(-5*roundedJ) and multiply roundedHu then present it as original DD force.
minimum_nonduplicate_implementable_funct.minimum_new_read_scope_if_selected: Original model connectivity/edofs plus body node/cell/fixed IDs and existing trace owner records, selected saved element_regularization_force and corresponding original global_regularization_force/nodal ledger. Additional P/J/Hu/kinematics or a force-kernel call are unnecessary to observe original Hu local action. Actual scope and count remain for root/author to decide in a future concrete card.
minimum_nonduplicate_implementable_funct.output_meaning: Original element vertex internal and ON-body force values in N, owner edge/corner classification, selected adjacent-pair and corner actions, original nodal association. Clearly distinguish element vertices from macroscopic workpiece corners and weak derivative action from pressure.
minimum_nonduplicate_implementable_funct.possible_verification: Replay the unchanged original C-order regularization scatter against the saved global vector if that operation is selected and authorized; copied local-to-node association is a data provenance check. Original rounded-force pair patterns and future local regrouping need explicitly justified tolerances or descriptive differences. This basis does not introduce a numerical gate or assume exact reconstructed beta equality.
minimum_nonduplicate_implementable_funct.avoid_duplicates: No new general body resultant API,24-state ledger, existing three-component deformed GIF, body-force HP projection, DD/P reconstruction or total-energy check is needed for this minimal Hu interpretation function.
minimum_nonduplicate_implementable_funct.formal_qualification: It advances the total generalized boundary interpretation, but leaves contact/pressure/effective-grip and mesh/domain stability flags unchanged. None of this alone makes a qualified physical pressure or effective holding force.
